question: Can observable timestamp formats and aggregate coordinates discriminate possible format/CRS labeling errors without selecting an interpretation or touching withheld data?

time_hypotheses.purpose: test consistency with alternating 12h records, not authorized correction
negative control for ambiguity, not authorized correction

time_diagnostics: hour-of-day histogram for timestamped records; no dates or IDs
aggregate counts of within-(Herd,AID,SeasnYr,Season) consecutive gaps within 10-14h under T1/T2
aggregate counts of zero or negative gaps, gaps >24h and >=3-valid-fix groups
report only summary counts, not per-individual track or timestamp
crs_diagnostic: transform ONLY the already-rounded spatial bounding-box center from the prior aggregate receipt into approximate longitude/latitude; compare broad geographic plausibility to published Wyoming herds but do not change PRJ, data or model CRS
